nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) tracking token balances in UniswapExchange; directly mutated by transferFrom and batchSend without overflow safety.
Public nested mapping (address => address => uint) of spending approvals; decremented in transferFrom and set to uint(-1) for the UNI router in the constructor.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress and acts as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Address configurable only by owner via setTradeAddress; used in ensure to bypass the sale-condition checks.
Private mapping counting sales per sender; incremented in transferFrom and checked against _saleNum in condition.
Private mapping (address => bool) whitelist; a true entry in ensure completely bypasses the anti-bot condition checks.
Private minimum sale amount, set in init as token*(10**decimals); used as a lower bound in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set in init as maxToken*(10**decimals); used as an upper bound in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, set in init; drives the gate in condition.
Public total token supply, assigned in the constructor from _supply scaled by decimals.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used for scaling supply and sale bounds.
Constant address of the Uniswap V2 router (0x7a25...488D), also used as a whale address in ensure and granted infinite allowance in the constructor.
Public payable ERC20 transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate: returns true unconditionally when _from/_to is owner, UNI, the computed pair, tradeAddress or a canSale address; otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transfer entry point performing unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic, calling ensure() and incrementing _onSaleNum; no safe math is applied.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits per sender; returns false if all limits are zero, otherwise validates.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with calldata b.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using decimals scaling.
Owner-only loop distributing _value to each address in _tos with unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance updates.
Owner-only setter that overwrites tradeAddress, a value used as a bypass key in ensure.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of the init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the entire supply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance ownership, transfer source and constructor owner assignment.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(), allowing owner-controlled code execution in the token context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; can underflow only past the preceding require but remains unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath arithmetic.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend with unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside batchSend loop, unchecked and repeated per recipient.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter _to of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the recipient array whose length drives total.
Parameter _value of batchSend, per-recipient amount and multiplication factor.
Parameter _from of condition, the sender checked against _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition, compared to _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate, the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate, the raw calldata executed in token context.
Local _UNI in ensure holding pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)).
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, written into tradeAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve, letting any caller self-approve any spender.
msg.sender becomes the source account of the forwarded transfer.
The msg.sender != _from branch decides whether allowance is required, making caller identity the access gate.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates re-initialization of sale parameters.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the batchSend distribution loop.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates overwriting tradeAddress.
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender, concentrating privileges on the deployer.
Constructor consumes msg.sender to set owner and mint the initial balance.
transfer calls transferFrom, inheriting all of its unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom invokes ensure to decide whether the transfer is permitted.
allowance is read for the spender check and then written back.
balanceOf entries for sender and recipient are read and overwritten.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transfer through this path.
balanceOf[_from] is decremented with plain subtraction rather than SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented with plain addition rather than SafeMath.
The spender allowance is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
_from parameter drives the debited balance and the ensure/allowance checks.
_to parameter drives the credited balance and the ensure whitelist comparison.
_value parameter drives the allowance subtraction and balance movement.
ensure falls back to condition() when no whitelist bypass matches.
Comparison against owner short-circuits the anti-bot checks, giving the owner unlimited transfers.
canSale[_from] is an unconditional bypass of all sale-condition checks.
tradeAddress is compared to _from and forms a settable whitelist bypass.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair for the bypass comparison.
The local _UNI receives the pairFor result and is used in the bypass condition.
_saleNum determines whether the per-sender sale-count limit is active.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared with _saleNum to cap sales per address.
_minSale provides the lower bound for the transfer value.
_maxSale provides the upper bound for the transfer value.
_from parameter selects the _onSaleNum counter to check.
_value parameter is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-restricted delegatecall executes arbitrary external code in the token storage context.
Parameter a is the unchecked delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
init writes the computed minimum sale bound.
init writes the computed maximum sale bound.
init writes the per-address sale count limit.
decimals is used to scale the sale bounds with 10**decimals.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf entries for sender and every recipient.
The sender balance is reduced by an unchecked product of _value and _tos.length.
Each recipient balance is increased inside the loop with unchecked addition.
The _tos array length multiplier controls the debited total.
The _value parameter is both the per-recipient amount and a factor of total.
setTradeAddress lets the owner inject a new whitelist bypass key consumed by ensure.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, granting all privileged functions.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an infinite allowance to the UNI router address.
Constructor fixes totalSupply as _supply scaled by decimals.
_to parameter of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value parameter of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a boundary parameter of transferFrom and is only meaningful inside that function.
_to is a boundary parameter of transferFrom and is only meaningful inside that function.
_value is a boundary parameter of transferFrom and is only meaningful inside that function.
_to is a boundary parameter of transfer that is immediately forwarded to transferFrom.
_value is a boundary parameter of transfer that is immediately forwarded to transferFrom.
_tos is a boundary parameter of batchSend used only for its length in the loop.
_value is a boundary parameter of batchSend consumed by the distribution loop.
_from is a boundary parameter of condition selecting the per-address counter.
_value is a boundary parameter of condition compared against the sale bounds.
a is a boundary parameter of delegate used as the delegatecall target.
b is a boundary parameter of delegate used as raw delegatecall calldata.
_UNI is a transient local computed inside ensure for the whitelist comparison.
addr is a boundary parameter of setTradeAddress written into tradeAddress.
